how_to_fix: Pass only valid Solid objects or sequences of Solid objects.
For intended face contact, make the solids share a finite-area face and retry; no artificial overlap is required.
For a real small gap, pass an explicit tol only when approximating that gap is acceptable.
Do not expect glue or tol to turn point-, edge-, or tangent-only contact into a valid single solid.
possible_causes: The operands touch without a finite-area face or positive-volume overlap.
repair: Give the contact a positive-volume overlap: translate one operand along (0, 0, 0) by a working overlap (e.g. 0.5 mm beyond touch) and retry.
For intended face contact, make the shared face finite in area and coincident; no artificial overlap is required.
bad_tol.technical_details: ValueError: tol must be a finite non-negative number
bad_tol.what_happened: operands meet only along an edge, vertex, or tangent (measured gap 0 mm ≤ tol 0), which is not one manifold solid

possible_causes: The operands are separated in space, so the union cannot produce exactly one solid.
A placement/translation moved one operand away from the other.
repair: Move operand 2 by (0.0001, 0, 0) (≥ 0.0001 mm) so the operands touch, or extend one operand across the gap.
If the pieces are meant to stay separate, build an assembly (make_assembly_rassembly) instead of a single-solid union.
gap_fails.technical_details: ValueError: union produced 2 separated solids; nearest detected gap is about 0.0001, which exceeds tol=2.44957e-07
gap_fails.what_happened: separated solids: operand 1 and operand 2 never touch; nearest detected gap is 0.0001 mm (tolerance 2.45e-07)
